column1: # Issue #367 recorded source sites (pinned Geargrafx b49ae82a). Locations and verdicts only, no source text.
# Roles: device_store = written without a CPU store in the same call; cpu_store = a CPU store reaches
# the target through Memory::Write / a hardware register write; reset_store = Memory::Reset fill;
# host_store = host API (state load, file load) writes guest RAM; cpu_block_store = one of the five
# block-transfer byte stores. Verdicts: NOT_MAIN_RAM = target is not the 32 KiB WRAM (m_wram);
# RESET_ONLY / HOST_ONLY = written only at reset / by the host; CPU_ORIGINATED = reached only via a
# CPU store (the store site itself is not device-autonomous); PER_BYTE_STEP = one byte per
